import asyncio

async def batch_run({{items}}, {{call_fn}}, {{concurrency}}=10):
    sem = asyncio.Semaphore({{concurrency}})
    async def worker(x):
        async with sem: return await {{call_fn}}(x)
    return await asyncio.gather(*[worker(i) for i in {{items}}])
